name: Chulian Riji
source:
School Years is a series of visual novel adapted from real stories. It is divided into three stages: high school, University and social work to tell a common and tortuous life trajectory.
Here is the first chapter of the series. In this chapter you will experience the life of a high school student in China. The protagonist lives and studies under the background of examination-oriented education in senior high schools in China with the expectation of the future and the expectation of ignorance of emotions. During his junior year, he has experienced many things which deeply impressed on him.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125480/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《初恋日记》是一部根据真实故事改编的视觉小说系列，分为高中、大学与步入社会工作三个阶段，讲述一段平凡而曲折的人生历程。
本作是系列的第一章，你将在这里体验一名中国高中生的生活。主人公怀着对未来的期待、对懵懂感情的憧憬，在中国高中应试教育的大环境下生活与学习。在高三这一年，他经历了许多令自己刻骨铭心的事情。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125480/]Steam[/url]]
